'''Margherita''' is a shop NPC in {{Location|Ragunna|nocat=1}}. She is the owner of [[Trattoria Margherita]]. 

==Profile==
A culinary genius, Margherita is famous for her mastery of her Echo Cooker, [[Bakie]]. Many of her dishes come from altering traditional recipes.

She is a childhood friend of [[Giovanetta]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} I want to check the recipes.
:;(Opens [[shop]])
::'''Margherita:''' Welcome to Margherita's! Your pizza will be hot and fresh in no time!

:;(Purchase items)
::'''Margherita:''' Come by more often—don't be a stranger!

:{{DIcon}} Chat
;(At day)
::'''Margherita:''' Chop, chop, chop, the orders are coming in hot, hot hot!
::'''Margherita:''' The pizza paddle is firing sparks!
::'''Margherita:''' Bakie, it's time  for a break! Don't overwork yourself, I'll squirrel these orders away!
::'''Margherita:''' Ding! Banker's Boost Platter, fresh out of the oven!
::'''Margherita:''' Ding! Gondola Tea and Pastry Tower!
::'''Margherita:''' Ding! Margherita's Victory Feast, served up with flair!
:{{DIcon}} Your business is on fire...
::'''Margherita:''' Ah, {{Rover}}!
::'''Margherita:''' Feeling hungry? I'll whip up the Gold Star treatment for you anytime you like!
:{{DIcon}} No, I'm good, really.
::'''Margherita:''' Are you sure? I heard you've been very busy running around today!
:{{DIcon}} I appreciate it, but I'm okay.
::'''Margherita:''' Make sure you eat well, no skipping meals, you hear!
::'''Margherita:''' Bakie's stove will be crackling and ready for you whenever you want it!
::'''Margherita:''' Also, no cappuccinos after lunch, or I'll be mad at you!
:{{DIcon}} Noted.
----
;(At night)
::'''Margherita:''' Phew... finally done for the day, and it all went smooth as butter!
::'''Margherita:''' Ah! It's {{Rover}}!
::'''Margherita:''' [[Bakie]]! Fire up a special treat, quick!
::'''Margherita:''' So late, my friend! Your stomach must be growing.
::{{DIcon}} Margherita—
::{{DIcon}} Bakie—
::'''Margherita:''' Margherita's doors are open for you anytime.
::'''Margherita:''' And don't forget, no going hungry in Ragunna!
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave 
{{Dialogue End}}
